description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Jarvan IV's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal '''bonus''' physical damage equal to 8% of the target's '''current''' health, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-[[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] targets.
description.text: Innate: Jarvan IV's basic attacks are empowered to deal bonus physical damage equal to 8% of the target's current health, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non- champion targets.

description2.raw: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
description2.text: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

notes.raw: * ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is based on the current health of the target before any damage of the attack has been dealt. * ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is dealt after the main attack damage. ** If the target dies to the main attack damage, the additional damage will not be dealt. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]].
notes.text:
Martial Cadence's damage is based on the current health of the target before any damage of the attack has been dealt.
Martial Cadence's damage is dealt after the main attack damage.
* If the target dies to the main attack damage, the additional damage will not be dealt.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.
